approaches.name: Static Trace Report
approaches.description: Extend trace-run to write a local HTML report summarizing steps, activation boundaries, freshness, and captured responses.
strengths: Generated from the actual runtime path.
Works without a server or new dependency.
approaches.implementation_shape: Add reporting module, wire trace_runner to emit index.html, update demo script and README, add tests.

approaches.name: CLI Guided Demo
approaches.description: Add a richer command-line walkthrough that prints selected artifacts and prompts the user to inspect them.
weaknesses: Harder to share with non-technical reviewers.
approaches.implementation_shape: Update shell script and CLI output only.

approaches.name: Local Web Dashboard
approaches.description: Build a small local web UI for browsing traces and artifacts.
weaknesses: Too much infrastructure before the contracts are settled.
Higher testing burden and UI scope.
approaches.implementation_shape: New web server or frontend app, static assets, route handling, and browser tests.

recommendation_rationale: It gets Braydon to a testable user surface while preserving the trace-driven build discipline and avoiding premature app infrastructure.
